en: The image depicts a commemorative plaque mounted on a stone wall. The plaque features a bronze or dark metal relief bust of a man in historical attire, presumably Klimó György, along with engraved text below the bust. The corners of the plaque are adorned with decorative fasteners that resemble a cross pattern. The plaque is dedicated to Klimó György, with his birth and death years (1710-1777) and a date likely marking the plaque's installation or a commemorative event (1977 May 2). The language of the text is Hungarian.
